description: List the digital collections of the Library of Congress: bodies of material a curator chose, described and published together. Use it to see what is there before searching, since a collection names a corpus that a query would have to guess at. 'collection_filter' on each row is the wording search_items takes as its 'collection' argument, and 'searchable_media_types' names the catalogues that filter can be sent to. A collection whose 'searchable_media_types' is empty gathers a kind of thing the catalogue search is not divided into, such as web archives; set 'searchable_only' to leave those out. 'item_count' is how many records the collection gathers, which is the size of the corpus rather than the number of rows here.

searchable_only.description: Keep only the collections whose formats name a media_type, which are the ones search_items can be asked for.

name: list_collections

collection_filter.description: Pass as 'collection' to search_items, together with one of 'searchable_media_types', to keep results within this collection.

formats.description: Kinds of thing the collection holds.

identifier.description: The slug the collection is addressed by.

item_count.description: Records the collection gathers. Null when the Library states none.

items_url.description: Lists what the collection holds, page by page.

searchable_media_types.description: The 'media_type' values search_items can be asked with for this collection, read off the formats the Library publishes for it. Empty when none of those formats names a catalogue.

total.description: Collections the Library publishes, not the number returned.

title: List the digital collections
